title: Do you anticipate the delay?
hook: Two stated cases: explore anticipating a future reversal under an explicit rule.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How anticipating a future reversal under an explicit rule affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Advantage, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare anticipating a future reversal under an explicit rule in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy model values immediate 8 normally, but delayed 12 after 1 periods as Beta 0.5 times Delta 1 to the delay. What is delayed minus immediate value?
